items.text: Keep the last block/unblock ruling across an in-flight reconcile PR: rulingsDrops must not drop a pending entry while an open reconcile PR's retro-gates.yaml can still change what main shows (e.g. drop only when main shows it and no reconcile PR is open); tests for block then unblock with the first PR open, and the mirror (C1)

Make the GitHub readRulings cursor never pass a comment it has not returned, so with two or more inboxes a comment posted on one issue while another is read is read on a later run; adapter and contract tests for a comment posted between two issue reads (C2)

nextCoordinator adds waiting-on-maintainer: only when every idle reason is a Maintainer cause, and the inbox step clears the stale body of every open xarabot-inbox issue that is not an owner's current inbox (unassigned or duplicate); tests for both (C7, C8)

Bring docs up to the as-built rulings: fix self-host.md:623 and :644, add a comment-rulings section (grammar, verbs and authority, replies, pending list, dismissals, xarabot rule), name readRulings and ruling replies in app-permissions.md's issues row, name xarabot-rule in GoSchema's comment (A3, A4)

Consolidate Epic 4's duplicated rules: one exported open-item status predicate, one inbox ownership and listing rule shared by renderDigest and inboxOwner, the digest stamp through coordinatorSwap, one forge-call and log helper for the inbox and rulings steps, unitKind() in retro-gates-edit.ts (D1, D2)

Run bmad-correct-course for Epic 4's drift: spine ledger v6, pending_rulings in AD-28, the Forge port's inbox operations, SPEC CAP-9 and Escalations; decide how settled deferrals (4.1-d1, 4.6-d1) leave the digest, dismissal pruning and recurrence, an early checkpoint go, resolves merge order and the first null-cursor read; route the residuals; close Epic 3 item 7 (A4-A6, C3-C6)
